TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Receives pricingRuleRequest and validates pricingRuleRequest.effectiveDate.startDate against pricingRuleRequest.effectiveDate.endDate; if the validation detects an invalid date combination, the flow raises advice ABKO10000404. It also evaluates duplicate candidates using pricingRuleRequest.details together with pricingRuleRequest.fee and resolves the descriptive value of each detail identifier before insert. 2. If pricingRuleRequest.details is null or empty, duplicate validation is skipped. If pricingRuleRequest.name is null or blank, a rule name is generated from the fee and detail data before persistence. If precedenceType, progressiveType or status are not set, defaults CUSTOMIZE, UNIQUE and PAA are applied during persistence. 3. The transaction invokes library ABKOR001.executePostPricingRules, which validates dates, checks duplicate pricing rules, resolves detail values, obtains the request header user code, creates audit records, inserts the pricing rule and inserts each pricing rule detail. 4. If the library raises a PricingRuleException, it is converted into an advice with description and, when the transaction detects accumulated advices, it sets severity EWR for the advice list. 5. On success, the flow returns pricingRuleResponse with the same pricing rule enriched with the generated id, resolved detail values and any generated or defaulted values applied before persistence.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Creates a pricing rule after validating dates, checking duplicate rules, resolving detail values, creating audit records and inserting the pricing rule with its details.
